integrity: Analytic proof provided; exact-rational tests are diagnostic, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact prescribed equal-duration two-level substrate, linear uncoupled populations, distinct Monod half-saturation constants, common mortality; no resource feedback, storage, response lag, noise, or experimental calibration. Historical priority subject to fuller comparison of 1990 resource-competition paper.
title: A geometric-mean threshold for reentrant Monod growth rankings under two-level nutrient forcing
